title: Tiny, cute violin
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- violin body -->
    <path d='M50,38 C38,38 32,46 34,55 C35,62 40,65 40,71 C40,77 44,82 50,82 C56,82 60,77 60,71 C60,65 65,62 66,55 C68,46 62,38 50,38 Z' fill='#C87A3A'/>
    <!-- upper bout shading -->
    <path d='M50,38 C42,38 36,43 35,50 C40,46 45,44 50,44 C55,44 60,46 65,50 C64,43 58,38 50,38 Z' fill='#E09A55'/>
    <!-- waist shading -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='11' ry='5' fill='#A85E28'/>
    <!-- f-holes -->
    <path d='M42,55 C40,58 40,63 42,66' stroke='#5A2E10' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M58,55 C60,58 60,63 58,66' stroke='#5A2E10' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- bridge -->
    <rect x='44' y='66' width='12' height='3' rx='1' fill='#F0C060'/>
    <!-- tailpiece -->
    <path d='M46,74 L54,74 L52,82 L48,82 Z' fill='#6B3A1A'/>
    <!-- fingerboard/neck -->
    <rect x='47' y='15' width='6' height='26' fill='#2E1A5E'/>
    <!-- neck shading -->
    <rect x='50' y='15' width='3' height='26' fill='#4A2E8A'/>
    <!-- scroll -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='13' r='4' fill='#2E1A5E'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='13' r='2' fill='#4A2E8A'/>
    <!-- strings -->
    <line x1='48' y1='17' x2='48' y2='68' stroke='#FFE8A0' stroke-width='1'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='17' x2='50' y2='68' stroke='#FFE8A0' stroke-width='1'/>
    <line x1='52' y1='17' x2='52' y2='68' stroke='#FFE8A0' stroke-width='1'/>
    <!-- chinrest -->
    <ellipse cx='43' cy='79' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#5A2E10'/>
    <!-- bow -->
    <line x1='20' y1='30' x2='80' y2='70' stroke='#D8C8A0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='20' y1='30' x2='20' y2='34' stroke='#8A5A2A' stroke-width='2'/>
    <!-- smile face on violin -->
    <circle cx='46' cy='50' r='1.5' fill='#3A1A0A'/>
    <circle cx='54' cy='50' r='1.5' fill='#3A1A0A'/>
    <path d='M46,54 Q50,58 54,54' stroke='#3A1A0A' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
</svg>
